title: Prescribing cascades relevant to older adults - machine-readable knowledge base

definition.text: A prescribing cascade occurs when an adverse drug event is misinterpreted as a new medical condition and a further drug is prescribed to treat it.

pipc2025.citation: Rochon PA, O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, et al. International expert panel's potentially inappropriate prescribing cascades (PIPC) list. Eur Geriatr Med. 2025;16(5):1573-1584 (correction: 2026;17(1):409-410, licence changed to CC BY 4.0).
pipc2025.design: Delphi consensus, 12 international experts; 65 cascades accepted (>=75% agreement).

rochon2026bmj.citation: Rochon PA, Austin PC, Gurwitz JH, et al. Exploring high priority potentially inappropriate prescribing cascades in older adults: population level retrospective cohort study. BMJ. 2026;394:e100499.
rochon2026bmj.design: Ontario, 2,297,942 community-dwelling adults >=66 y; prescription sequence symmetry analysis (PSSA) of all 65 PIPCs, 1-year window (180-day sensitivity analysis), accrual 2022-2023. Prioritised = initial-drug prevalence >=5%, cascade incidence >=1%/yr and adjusted sequence ratio (aSR) >1, each with lower 95% CI above threshold.

thinkcascades2022.citation: McCarthy LM, Savage R, Dalton K, et al. ThinkCascades: a tool for identifying clinically important prescribing cascades affecting older people. Drugs Aging. 2022;39(10):829-840.
thinkcascades2022.design: Modified Delphi, 38-40 clinicians from 6 countries; 139 cascades rated; final tool of 9 clinically important cascades.

doherty2022.citation: Doherty AS, Shahid F, Moriarty F, et al. Prescribing cascades in community-dwelling adults: a systematic review. Pharmacol Res Perspect. 2022;10(5):e01008.
doherty2022.design: Systematic review of 101 studies; cascades occurred within 3 months to 1 year of the first drug.

rochon1997.citation: Rochon PA, Gurwitz JH. Optimising drug treatment for elderly people: the prescribing cascade. BMJ. 1997;315(7115):1096-1099.

rochon2017.citation: Rochon PA, Gurwitz JH. The prescribing cascade revisited. Lancet. 2017;389(10081):1778-1780.

mccarthy2019.citation: McCarthy LM, Visentin JD, Rochon PA. Assessing the scope and appropriateness of prescribing cascades. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2019;67(5):1023-1026.

savage2020.citation: Savage RD, Visentin JD, Bronskill SE, et al. Evaluation of a common prescribing cascade of calcium channel blockers and diuretics in older adults with hypertension. JAMA Intern Med. 2020;180(5):643-651.
savage2020.finding: Ontario adults >=66 y with hypertension: new CCB users had higher 90-day cumulative incidence of loop-diuretic dispensing (1.4% vs 0.7% ACEi/ARB and 0.5% unrelated drugs); adjusted HR vs ACEi/ARB 1.68 (days 1-30), 2.26 (31-60), 2.40 (61-90); association persisted to 1 year.

vouri2019.citation: Vouri SM, Jiang X, Manini TM, et al. Magnitude of and characteristics associated with the treatment of calcium channel blocker-induced lower-extremity edema with loop diuretics. JAMA Netw Open. 2019;2(12):e1918425.
vouri2019.finding: PSSA in 1.2 million dihydropyridine-CCB initiators: aSR 1.87 (95% CI 1.84-1.90) for loop diuretic within 360 days; stronger with high doses (aSR 2.20) and amlodipine (1.89); ~1.44% of initiators experienced the cascade.

rochon2024.citation: Rochon PA, Austin PC, Normand SL, et al. Association of a calcium channel blocker and diuretic prescribing cascade with adverse events: a population-based cohort study. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2024;72(2):467-478.
rochon2024.finding: 4.8% of 39,347 new CCB users with hypertension received a new diuretic within 90 days; this cascade group had more ED visits/hospitalisations over 90 days (HR 1.21, 95% CI 1.02-1.43).

vegter2010.citation: Vegter S, de Jong-van den Berg LT. Misdiagnosis and mistreatment of a common side-effect--angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor-induced cough. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2010;69(2):200-203.
vegter2010.finding: PSSA (Netherlands, 27,446 incident ACEi users): antitussives started after vs before ACEi within a half-year span, adjusted sequence ratio 2.2 (95% CI 1.9-2.4); estimated ~15% of ACEi cough treated with antitussives.

gurwitz1994.citation: Gurwitz JH, Avorn J, Bohn RL, et al. Initiation of antihypertensive treatment during nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug therapy. JAMA. 1994;272(10):781-786.
gurwitz1994.finding: Case-control, NJ Medicaid >=65 y: recent NSAID users had higher odds of starting antihypertensive therapy (adjusted OR 1.66, 95% CI 1.54-1.80), rising with NSAID dose (1.55 low, 1.64 medium, 1.82 high).

gill2005.citation: Gill SS, Mamdani M, Naglie G, et al. A prescribing cascade involving cholinesterase inhibitors and anticholinergic drugs. Arch Intern Med. 2005;165(7):808-813.
gill2005.finding: Ontario cohort of 44,884 older adults with dementia: ChEI users more likely to receive an anticholinergic for urinary incontinence (4.5% vs 3.1%; adjusted HR 1.55, 95% CI 1.39-1.72).

masurkar2021.citation: Masurkar PP, Chatterjee S, Sherer JT, Aparasu RR. Antimuscarinic cascade across individual cholinesterase inhibitors in older adults with dementia. Drugs Aging. 2021;38(7):593-602.
masurkar2021.finding: 47,059 incident ChEI users: 3.7% started an antimuscarinic within 6 months; donepezil vs rivastigmine adjusted HR 1.55 (1.31-1.83).

tucker2026.citation: Tucker SB, Love BL, Okeke CM, et al. Association between cholinesterase inhibitor-overactive bladder antimuscarinic prescribing cascade and risk of delirium and falls among individuals living with dementia. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2026;74(5):1314-1325.
tucker2026.finding: Used a 60-day window after ChEI start to define the cascade; vs mirabegron, delirium/fall estimates were imprecise (compatible with benefit, harm or no difference).

avorn1995jama.citation: Avorn J, Gurwitz JH, Bohn RL, et al. Increased incidence of levodopa therapy following metoclopramide use. JAMA. 1995;274(22):1780-1782.
avorn1995jama.finding: Case-control (NJ Medicaid >=65 y): metoclopramide users ~3 times more likely to start levodopa (OR 3.09, 95% CI 2.25-4.26), with dose-response.

avorn1995ajm.citation: Avorn J, Bohn RL, Mogun H, et al. Neuroleptic drug exposure and treatment of parkinsonism in the elderly: a case-control study. Am J Med. 1995;99(1):48-54.
avorn1995ajm.finding: Neuroleptic use in the 90 days before was associated with 5.4-fold odds of starting antiparkinsonian medication and 2.2-fold odds of starting a dopaminergic drug; 37% of dopaminergic starts attributable to prior neuroleptic use.

kalish1995.citation: Kalish SC, Bohn RL, Mogun H, et al. Antipsychotic prescribing patterns and the treatment of extrapyramidal symptoms in older people. J Am Geriatr Soc. 1995;43(9):967-973.
kalish1995.finding: Antipsychotics were often not stopped or reduced before antiparkinsonian drugs were added (discontinued in only 12% of those started on anticholinergic antiparkinsonian drugs).

gurwitz1997.citation: Gurwitz JH, Kalish SC, Bohn RL, et al. Thiazide diuretics and the initiation of anti-gout therapy. J Clin Epidemiol. 1997;50(8):953-959.
gurwitz1997.finding: Cohort of 9,249 adults >=65 y followed up to 2 years: thiazide monotherapy RR 1.99 (1.21-3.26) for starting anti-gout therapy; increased risk only at >=25 mg/day hydrochlorothiazide-equivalent.

read2021.citation: Read SH, Giannakeas V, Pop P, et al. Evidence of a gabapentinoid and diuretic prescribing cascade among older adults with lower back pain. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2021;69(10):2842-2850.
read2021.finding: Ontario adults >=66 y with new low back pain: new gabapentinoid users more often received a diuretic within 90 days (2.0% vs 1.3%; adjusted HR 1.44, 1.23-1.70), increasing with dose.

growdon2025jno.citation: Growdon ME, Tjota N, Campbell R, et al. Decision-making and downstream outcomes of the gabapentinoid-diuretic prescribing cascade. JAMA Netw Open. 2025;8(12):e2545274.
growdon2025jno.finding: Chart review of 120 US veterans: gabapentinoids were almost never documented in the differential for edema (3.3%); downstream events after loop diuretic start included worsening kidney function and orthostasis.

hayes2026.citation: Hayes KN, Belanger E, Oganisian A, et al. Predictors of a gabapentinoid-loop-diuretic prescribing cascade in U.S. nursing home residents. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2026;74(2):336-344.
hayes2026.finding: 4.2% of 23,544 nursing-home residents started a loop diuretic within 90 days of a gabapentinoid, median 36 days (IQR 15-61) after initiation.

growdon2025jgms.citation: Growdon ME, Jing B, Deardorff WJ, et al. Loop diuretics and subsequent use of urinary symptom medications in older adults: evaluation of a possible prescribing cascade. J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci. 2025;80(8):glaf150.
growdon2025jgms.finding: US veterans (99% male) starting loop diuretics: NO overall cascade signal (aSR 0.74, 0.73-0.76) for urinary symptom medications within 6 months; a signal appeared only in men with heart failure without baseline urinary symptoms (aSR 1.24).

vouri2022.citation: Vouri SM, Morris EJ, Jiang X, et al. Evaluation of a beta-blocker-edema-loop diuretic prescribing cascade: a prescription sequence symmetry analysis. Am J Hypertens. 2022;35(7):601-609.
vouri2022.finding: 988,675 beta-blocker initiators: loop diuretic started within 90 days after vs before, aSR 1.78 (1.72-1.84); higher in older adults (1.97).

engineGuidance.language: Never say a drug caused a symptom. Say 'X was started N days after Y; Y is known to sometimes cause Z (source). Worth asking the prescriber.'
engineGuidance.ranking: Rank: ThinkCascades or Ontario-prioritised first; then entries with populationSignal true; entries with populationSignal false/null are still valid individual-level prompts but lower priority (MedWatch heuristic).
engineGuidance.diaryLink: diarySymptoms links to symptom ids in symptom-adr-map.json so a diary symptom (e.g. ankle_swelling) can surface the relevant cascade.

cascades.clinicianNote: ACEi cough is a labelled adverse reaction; PSSA evidence shows excess antitussive starts after ACEi initiation (Vegter 2010). Consider whether cough predates the ACEi before continuing antitussives.

cascades.plainLanguage: Calcium channel blockers such as amlodipine commonly cause ankle swelling. Sometimes a 'water pill' is added to treat the swelling instead of adjusting the blood-pressure medicine. If a water pill was started within a few months after amlodipine, ask whether the swelling could be a side effect.
cascades.clinicianNote: Amlodipine label: edema is the most common adverse reaction and is dose-related. Loop-diuretic starts rise within 30-90 days of CCB initiation (Savage 2020) and the cascade is associated with more ED visits/hospitalisations (Rochon 2024). Highest risk with dihydropyridines and higher doses (Vouri 2019).
